DYNF.description: Railway Dynamic Factor by Element (DYNF). INPUT_TYPE selects which fields apply: 0 uses LENGTH/MAINTAIN_TYPE/OPT_REDUCE_EFF (and HEIGHT_COVER when reduced effect is on); 1 uses DYN_FACTOR. Keyed by element number.

INPUT_TYPE.description: Dynamic factor input method. 0 = Auto (compute from determinant length and track maintenance); 1 = User Input (directly specify the dynamic factor).

LENGTH.description: [INPUT_TYPE=0] Determinant length Lφ used to compute the dynamic factor.

MAINTAIN_TYPE.description: [INPUT_TYPE=0] Quality of track maintenance. 0 = Carefully maintained; 1 = Standard maintenance.

OPT_REDUCE_EFF.description: [INPUT_TYPE=0] Whether to consider the reduced dynamic effect. When true, HEIGHT_COVER is required.

HEIGHT_COVER.description: [INPUT_TYPE=0, OPT_REDUCE_EFF=true] Height of cover h used to reduce the dynamic effect.

DYN_FACTOR.description: [INPUT_TYPE=1] User-specified dynamic factor φ applied directly.
